content.heading: Reviving Grand Court Recipes with Modern Finesse
content.description: Founded in 2018, The Saffron Lounge was born from a passion to preserve authentic royal Indian cooking techniques that time has nearly forgotten. Our Master Chefs hail from traditional culinary lineages of Lucknow and Rajasthan, meticulously balancing 42 native botanical spices, slow-simmering gravies over smoldering coals, and baking handcrafted artisan naans on natural terracotta walls.
features: Zero Artificial Additives, Food Colors, or Preservatives
Hand-Selected Kashmiri Grade-A Saffron & Himalayan Herbs
Live Sitar & Classical Flute Recitals Every Friday to Sunday

content.heading: Signature Culinary Offerings
content.description: Each dish is prepared à la minute with uncompromised attention to fragrance, texture, and authentic royal spice profiles.

items.title: Dal Saffron Bukhara
items.description: Whole black lentils slow-simmered over charcoal embers for 18 hours with vine-ripened tomatoes, country butter, and fenugreek.

items.title: Smoked Paneer Angara Tikka
items.description: Fresh farmhouse malai paneer steeped in roasted mustard oil, hand-pounded Kashmiri chili, and grilled over red-hot coals.

items.title: Nawabi Subz Dum Biryani
items.description: Aged long-grain basmati rice layered with garden vegetables, saffron milk, and rose water, sealed in an earthen pot.

items.title: Truffle & Garlic Naan
items.description: Hand-stretched organic leavened flatbread baked in terracotta tandoor, drizzled with white truffle oil and fresh herbs.

items.title: Shahi Tukda Saffron Brioche
items.description: Crispy ghee-toasted brioche soaked in cardamom milk reduction, crowned with silver vark and crushed pistachio rabri.

items.title: Charred Jamun & Guava Mocktail
items.description: Hand-muddled pink guava with black salt, roasted cumin, and charred chili smoke served in a chilled copper goblet.

content.heading: The Royal Degustation Platters
content.description: Curated multi-course tasting journeys designed for sharing among family, friends, and distinguished guests.

items.name: Maharaja Royal Thali Experience
items.description: A lavish feast comprising 3 royal curries, Dal Saffron Bukhara, choice of 3 tandoori breads, saffron dum biryani, signature raita, and twin artisan desserts.

items.name: The Tandoori Kebabs & Grill Assortment
items.description: Smoked paneer angara, stuffed malai khumb (mushrooms), tandoori broccoli florets, and soya chaap roasted over fragrant wood coals.

content.heading: Weekend Table Reservation Privilege
content.description: Book your table online for 4 guests or more and receive complimentary handcrafted Chef's signature desserts along with artisanal welcome mocktails on arrival.

content.heading: Why Connoisseurs Choose The Saffron Lounge
content.description: We don't merely serve meals; we orchestrate an unforgettable multisensory Indian banquet steeped in hospitality and grandeur.

points.title: Master Chefs of Royal Lineage
points.description: Over two decades of culinary mastery perfecting Awadhi, Rajasthani, and Mughlai culinary methods.

points.title: Pure Hand-Stone Ground Spices
points.description: We never purchase pre-ground spices; whole spices are roasted and pounded fresh every morning.

points.title: 100% Pure Vegetarian & Jain Specialization
points.description: Independent preparation station dedicated to sattvic and Jain culinary preferences with zero compromise on taste.

points.title: Intimate Royal Ambience & Live Music
points.description: Carved jali screens, warm amber candelabras, and live acoustic sitar recitals create an oasis of tranquility.

points.title: Valet Parking & Dedicated Host Concierge
points.description: Seamless arrival experience with complimentary valet parking right on Sindhu Bhavan Road.

content.name: Chef Ranveer Singhania
content.title: Executive Chef & Culinary Director
content.bio: With over 22 years of illustrious culinary experience across leading luxury 5-star hotels in India and the Middle East, Chef Ranveer leads The Saffron Lounge with obsessive devotion to heritage recipes, ancient slow-cooking secrets, and soulful hospitality.
content.quote: True Indian royal cooking is not about heavy oil or excessive heat; it is an art of patience, where spices marry over gentle glowing embers to release their most delicate soul.

items.name: Dr. Ananya Trivedi
items.review: The Dal Saffron Bukhara is arguably the best in Gujarat. The charcoal notes are mellow, the creaminess is ethereal, and the acoustic sitar music in the background transforms dinner into a royal celebration.

items.name: Prakash Patel
items.review: We hosted our anniversary dinner in the Private Dining Suite. The personalized service, attention to Jain dietary preferences, and warm hospitality made our family feel like royalty. Unmatched quality.

items.name: Meera & Siddharth Joshi
items.review: From the smoked pink guava mocktails to the melt-in-the-mouth paneer angara and truffle naan, every single bite is pure perfection. Make sure to book your weekend table well in advance!

content.heading: Private Dining & Banquet Packages
content.description: Choose an all-inclusive multi-course banquet curated for celebrations, corporate meetings, and family gatherings.

plans.name: The Saffron Silver Feast
plans.description: Ideal for intimate family dinners and small gatherings (minimum 6 guests).

plans.name: The Royal Awadhi Banquet
plans.description: Our flagship dining package with dedicated private suite and personalized butler service.
features: Subz Dum Biryani & Dum Pukht Gravies
Choice of 4 Breads including Truffle Naan

plans.name: The Master Chef's Table
plans.description: An exclusive 7-course degustation personally prepared and introduced by Chef Ranveer.
features: Customized Menu with Rare Heritage Recipes
Commemorative Gift Box with Signature Spices

items.question: Is advance table reservation mandatory?
items.answer: While we warmly welcome walk-in guests whenever seating permits, we strongly recommend advance reservations for weekend dinners (Friday to Sunday) and for our Private Dining Suites to avoid wait times.

items.question: Is the restaurant 100% vegetarian, and do you cater to Jain dietary needs?
items.answer: Yes, The Saffron Lounge is a strictly 100% Pure Vegetarian restaurant. We have an extensive specialized Jain menu prepared in a dedicated area with zero onion, garlic, or root vegetables.

items.question: How do I book a Private Dining Room (PDR) for birthdays or corporate meetings?
items.answer: Our Private Dining Suites accommodate 10 to 45 guests. You can request a suite reservation directly through our online form or message our reservations manager on WhatsApp (+91 98980 12345).

items.question: Is valet parking available at the venue?
items.answer: Yes, complimentary valet parking is available at our main entrance on Sindhu Bhavan Road, Bodakdev for all our dining patrons.

items.question: What are your operating hours?
items.answer: We are open 7 days a week. Lunch is served from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM, and Dinner from 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM.
